provenance: Historical native reader and aggregate blocks from the repository-owned admitted producer; source pins are intentional historical evidence, not current tooling definitions.
caller:
---
on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
jobs:
  lockfile-release-age:
    name: Lockfile release age
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Preserve the aggregate result outside pull requests
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.event_name != 'merge_group'
        run: echo 'Lockfile release-age comparisons run for PR and merge queue candidates.'
      - name: Check out the exact pull-request candidate and base history
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out the shared lockfile policy
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/.github
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/.github currentValue=main
          ref: e362e4564f8e3c1d9d113242e3bf34011f2d7cd7
          path: .github/strukturpiloten-shared
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Reject newly introduced dependencies younger than three days
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group'
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for revision in "${BASE_SHA}" "${HEAD_SHA}"; do
            [[ "${revision}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          done
          if [[ "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}" == merge_group ]]; then
            test "${HEAD_SHA}" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
            git merge-base --is-ancestor "${BASE_SHA}" "${HEAD_SHA}"
          fi
          python3 .github/strukturpiloten-shared/scripts/lockfile_release_age.py \
            --repository-root "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}" \
            --base "${BASE_SHA}" --head "${HEAD_SHA}" --minimum-age-hours 72
  pr-gate:
    name: Required CI
    if: always()
    needs:
      [
        release-binaries,
        automation,
        canonical-artifact-integrity,
        kubernetes-artifact-integrity,
        compose-provider-integrity,
        validation-plan,
        rust,
        msrv,
        dependencies,
        documentation,
        release-metadata,
        semver-release-type,
        semver,
        coverage,
        migration-readiness,
        lockfile-release-age,
      ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out candidate aggregate verifier
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out trusted PR base aggregate verifier
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}
          path: .validation-base
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require every selected job to succeed and every skip to be planned
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha }}
          PLAN_JSON: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.plan }}
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          NEEDS_JSON=$(python3 - <<'BINARY_NEEDS_PY'
          import json
          import os
          def unique_object(pairs):
              result = {}
              for key, value in pairs:
                  if key in result:
                      raise ValueError("duplicate needs key")
                  result[key] = value
              return result
          needs = json.loads(os.environ["NEEDS_JSON"], object_pairs_hook=unique_object)
          if not isinstance(needs, dict):
              raise SystemExit("needs must be an object")
          for required in ("release-binaries", "automation", "canonical-artifact-integrity", "kubernetes-artifact-integrity", "compose-provider-integrity"):
              prerequisite = needs.get(required)
              if not isinstance(prerequisite, dict) or prerequisite.get("result") != "success":
                  raise SystemExit(f"{required} must succeed")
              del needs[required]
          print(json.dumps(needs, separators=(",", ":")))
          BINARY_NEEDS_PY
          )
          export NEEDS_JSON
          if [[ "${EVENT_NAME}" == 'merge_group' || ( "${EVENT_NAME}" == 'pull_request' &&
                ( ! -f .validation-base/scripts/validation-plan.py ||
                  ! -f .validation-base/scripts/validation-policy.json ) ) ]]; then
            # Bootstrap has no trusted verifier. Require the literal complete plan and all jobs.
            python3 - <<'PY' | tee -a "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
          import json
          import os

          jobs = "rust msrv dependencies documentation release-metadata semver-release-type semver coverage migration-readiness lockfile-release-age".split()
          plan = json.loads(os.environ["PLAN_JSON"])
          needs = json.loads(os.environ["NEEDS_JSON"])
          if (set(plan) != {"schema", "repository", "event", "base_sha", "head_sha", "tested_sha",
                            "profile", "jobs", "reasons", "local_fingerprint"}
                  or plan["schema"] != 2 or plan["repository"] != "Strukturpiloten/boxferry"
                  or plan["event"] != os.environ["EVENT_NAME"] or plan["profile"] != "full"
                  or plan["base_sha"] != os.environ["BASE_SHA"]
                  or plan["head_sha"] != os.environ["HEAD_SHA"]
            or (plan["event"] == "merge_group" and plan["head_sha"] != plan["tested_sha"])
                  or plan["tested_sha"] != os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"]
                  or plan["jobs"] != {job: True for job in jobs}
                  or set(needs) != {"validation-plan", *jobs}):
              raise SystemExit("first-rollout complete validation contract is missing or inconsistent")
          for job in ("validation-plan", *jobs):
              if needs[job].get("result") != "success":
                  raise SystemExit(f"first-rollout required job {job} did not succeed")
          print("First-rollout complete validation: every required job succeeded")
          PY
          else
            verifier=scripts/validation-plan.py
            policy_root=.
            if [[ "${EVENT_NAME}" == 'pull_request' ]]; then
              verifier=.validation-base/scripts/validation-plan.py
              policy_root=.validation-base
            fi
            python3 "${verifier}" gate --policy-root "${policy_root}" \
              --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
              --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" \
              --plan-json "${PLAN_JSON}" --needs-json "${NEEDS_JSON}" |
              tee -a "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
          fi
